==Ingredients==

* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (500 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]/1.1 [[Cookbook:Pint|pint]]) [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 1 cup (110 g/3.9 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) risotto [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 3 cups ({{convert|750|ml|USpt|abbr=on|disp=s}}) [[Cookbook:Half and Half|half and half]]
* 1 cup ({{convert|225|g|oz|abbr=on|disp=s}}) granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon stick]]
* 1 piece of [[Cookbook:Lemon rind|lemon peel]]
* [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|Ground cinnamon]] to [[Cookbook:Garnish|garnish]]

==Procedure==

# Bring water to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], then add rice, salt, and butter.
# Cover, lower heat to [[Cookbook:simmer|simmer]], and cook for 20 minutes.
# Place rice in upper part of [[Cookbook:Double Boiler|double boiler]] with half and half, sugar, cinnamon stick, and lemon peel.
# Bring to boil over direct heat.
# Place over simmering water in double boiler and cook for 45 minutes.
# Remove cinnamon stick and lemon peel.
# Pour rice mixture into a 2-[[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] (1.9 [[Cookbook:Liter|L]]) casserole and allow to cool.
# Sprinkle with cinnamon powder.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* The rice should be plump, medium grain rice that contains a lot of starch, like Arborio or Carnaroli. Other rices that work well are Roma, Nano, Maratelli, and Vialone.
* Mixture will thicken as it cools.
* Best at room temperature or slightly warm.
